title: Tick Tack Boom
intro.a: Only the player whose turn it is sees the bomb. The others have the manual – describe, look it up, give orders!
intro.b: The bomb is on the TV. Each module has one operator, and someone else has its manual. Shout it out!
intro.rules: Read the manual aloud, don't show it. Every strike makes the clock faster.
intro.mixed: Careful: the rules have been shuffled this time.
hasBomb: has the bomb on their phone
defuserHint: {name} describes what's on the bomb. Everyone else looks it up and says what to do.
speedup: After every strike the clock runs 25% faster.
getReady: The bomb is about to be armed …
tvSecret: Only {name} can see what's on the bomb. The TV won't tell.
end.lost: Guess that was the wrong wire …
final.title: {n} of {total} bombs defused
audience: You're watching. The bomb is ticking on the TV!
describe: Describe out loud what you see
roles.defuser: You're about to see the bomb. Describe it to the others – they have the manual.
roles.crew: The bomb is about to be armed. Start reading your manual!
helpOthers: Help the others with your manual.
knopf.holding: Holding … When to let go? Ask!
doppel.release: Green! Both let go at the same time!
doppel.hint: Both press and hold until the lamp is green.
frage.quiet: Quiet … the next question is coming.
